JSON_type_system.boolean: true or false; a boolean is never an integer or floating number
JSON_type_system.integer: a canonical JSON number token with no fraction or exponent, parsed without loss
JSON_type_system.floating: a canonical JSON number token with a fraction or exponent, parsed as IEEE-754 binary64
JSON_type_system.string: a JSON string compared by Unicode scalar sequence
JSON_type_system.array: an ordered JSON array; order and length are significant unless an operator says otherwise
JSON_type_system.object: a JSON object with unique keys; key order is never significant

strict_equal.algorithm: types must match exactly (including boolean distinct from integer and integer distinct from floating); nulls match; strings/booleans/numbers compare exactly; arrays require equal length and recursive position-wise strict_equal; objects require identical key sets and recursive strict_equal at every key

allclose.scalar_algorithm: both operands must be finite_numeric; abs(a-b) <= max(atol, rtol*max(abs(a),abs(b)))
allclose.array_algorithm: both operands must be arrays of equal length and allclose must hold recursively position-wise
allclose.rtol_atol_types: finite nonnegative floating or integer; booleans forbidden
allclose.missing_rtol_or_atol: use explicit rule value if present, otherwise 0.0

__PLAN_FIXTURE_IDS__.expansion: the exact ordered fixture_ids array from the bound H24 population manifest whose SHA-256 is H24_population_manifest_sha256
__PLAN_FIXTURE_IDS__.copy_semantics: expand before operator evaluation; no string comparison with the sentinel token is permitted

in.algorithm: exists option in expected such that strict_equal(value, option)

all_equal.algorithm: strict_equal(item, value[0]) for every item after value[0]

not_all_equal.algorithm: exists item after value[0] for which not strict_equal(item, value[0])

all_in.algorithm: for every item exists allowed option with strict_equal(item, option)

all_true.algorithm: every item is the JSON boolean true

none_in.algorithm: for every item, not (expected[0] <= item <= expected[1]); integer types exact and booleans forbidden

allclose_pairs.algorithm: allclose(pair[0], pair[1], rtol, atol) for every pair

allclose_all.algorithm: allclose(value[0], item, rtol, atol) for every later item

any_different_pair.algorithm: exists pair for which not strict_equal(pair[0], pair[1])

strictly_gain_ordered.algorithm: float64(value[i]) < float64(value[i+1]) for every adjacent pair

nonincreasing.algorithm: float64(value[i+1])-float64(value[i]) <= atol for every adjacent pair; rtol ignored

support_formula_exact.algorithm: each triple is [valid:boolean, frequency_hz:finite_numeric, observation_supported:boolean] and valid is exactly ((frequency_hz <= 22050.0) and observation_supported)

d08_traces_exact.algorithm: trace offsets in order must equal [0,1,255,256,3840,4095]; every object has exactly offset,event_hop,states,target_category,resolved_category,pending_lifetime; offset is integer; event_hop=offset//256; states is exactly ['INACTIVE'] plus 16 hop states (INACTIVE before event_hop, PENDING_NEW at event_hop, ACTIVE after), plus final ACTIVE iff 4096-offset<3840

timing_components_exact.algorithm: object keys exactly {window,hop,feature,inference,decoder,MIDI}; every value is an integer >=0 and boolean is forbidden

ts01_evidence_exact.algorithm: keys exactly {all_fixture_ids,passed_at_6,failed_at_6,rescued_at_16,rescued_at_32,regressed_at_16,regressed_at_32}; every value an array; all_fixture_ids equals lexicographically sorted expanded __PLAN_FIXTURE_IDS__; sorted(passed_at_6 concatenated with failed_at_6) equals all_fixture_ids; passed_at_6 and failed_at_6 are disjoint sets; rescued_at_16 and rescued_at_32 are subsets of failed_at_6; regressed_at_16 and regressed_at_32 are subsets of passed_at_6
